lines.en: label secondbeach1:
scene black
{i}Some people will tell you that there are only two guarantees in life-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有人会告诉你，这世上只有两件事是板上钉钉的——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Death and taxes, I think they say.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}死亡，还有纳税，他们大概是这么说的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But the truth is that there is a third guarantee.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但事实是，还有第三件。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Though, it’s one that’s a bit too artistic or pretentious to lump in with the others.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}只不过它有点太文艺、太矫情，不好和另外两件并排放在一起。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But I am an artistic and pretentious person, so I am going to do it anyway. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}可我恰恰就是个又文艺又矫情的人，所以偏要把它写上去。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The third guarantee is that there is beauty in everything around you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这第三件事就是：你身边的一切都有美。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It sticks to your clothing like cigarette smoke.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它像烟味一样黏在你的衣服上。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Clings to your skin like the nails of a house cat.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}像家猫的爪子一样勾着你的皮肤。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But despite all that, it can still be a little hard to see sometimes.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}尽管如此，它有时还是有点难被看见。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But it’s there.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但它就在那儿。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I promise.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我保证。{/i}

lines.en: {i}- No one{/i}
lines.zh: {i}——无名氏{/i}

lines.en: scene goodmorning1blur
My eyelids wage war with an incessant desire to sleep in and, just seconds after waking up, I can already tell that it’s going to be another day of losing battles or losing patience.
lines.zh: 我的眼皮和「再睡一会儿」的无尽欲望打得不可开交，而在醒来仅仅几秒之后，我就已经知道，今天又是不断输掉战斗、或者不断输掉耐心的一天。

lines.en: Or losing anything, really.
lines.zh: 老实说，输掉什么都行。

lines.en: Sense of self?
lines.zh: 自我？

lines.en: Sleep?
lines.zh: 睡眠？

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: But something will be lost.
lines.zh: 但总会失去点什么。

lines.en: I fight back against the desire to keep my eyes closed and attempt to figure out who the figure is before me.
lines.zh: 我强撑着不把眼睛闭上，试图辨认站在我面前的那个人影是谁。

lines.en: They haven’t crawled into my bed yet, so based on that assumption, it could probably only be one person.
lines.zh: 她还没钻进我的被窝，基于这一点，大概只可能是某一个人。

lines.en: : Maya?...
lines.zh: ：Maya？……

lines.en: scene goodmorning1
: Good morning.
lines.zh: ：早上好。

lines.en: : Good morning.
lines.zh: ：早上好。

lines.en: I decide not to say anything about how strange this is- not just because it’s too early for the banter to begin, but because I’m sure that the two of us are already acutely aware of it.
lines.zh: 我决定对这有多奇怪只字不提——不只是因为现在拌嘴还太早，而是因为我很清楚，我们俩心里都门儿清。

lines.en: And yet we remain in silence for a minute or two.
lines.zh: 可我们还是沉默了一两分钟。

lines.en: It doesn’t feel longer or anything like that.
lines.zh: 并没有显得更长之类的。

lines.en: It genuinely feels like a minute or two.
lines.zh: 真的就是一两分钟的感觉。

lines.en: But then the silence becomes uncomfortable and I find myself losing my first battle out of many to come.
lines.zh: 但接着沉默变得叫人难受，于是我输掉了今天诸多战斗中的第一场。

lines.en: : No good morning kiss?
lines.zh: ：没有早安吻吗？

lines.en: : Oh, look. Just two sentences in and I’m already regretting my decision to come here.
lines.zh: ：哦，瞧。才说了两句，我就已经在后悔来这儿了。

lines.en: : Sorry. Just a little confused as to why you decided to be my wake up call today.
lines.zh: ：抱歉。只是有点纳闷，今天怎么轮到你来叫我起床。

lines.en: : Hm.
: I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume that no one told you what today is.
lines.zh: ：我斗胆猜一句，应该没人告诉过你今天是什么日子。

lines.en: : You’d be very correct in assuming that.
lines.zh: ：你猜得一点没错。

lines.en: scene goodmorning2
: Well, I’m sure you’ll be able to figure it out the second you step into Ami’s room.
lines.zh: ：嗯，我相信你一踏进 Ami 的房间就会明白的。

lines.en: : Fortunately for me, I won’t be there to be ogled at half-naked this time around. Hooray.
lines.zh: ：对我来说幸运的是，这次我不会在那儿半裸着被人盯着看。万岁。

lines.en: I lose a second battle.
lines.zh: 我输掉了第二场。

lines.en: : The beach trip isn’t today, is it?
lines.zh: ：海滩旅行不是今天吧？

lines.en: scene goodmorning1
: It is. And at the risk of sounding excited, I’d like to inform you that I am very much not excited.
lines.zh: ：就是今天。虽然这么说听起来像是会很兴奋，但我想通知你：我一点都不兴奋。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure you needed the disclaimer if you were just going to come out and say it like that.
lines.zh: ：既然你都要这么直说了，我不太确定你还需要那句免责声明。

lines.en: : As {i}glad{/i} as I am to have {i}you{/i} back in {i}your own{/i} body, it is once again making things very difficult for me.
lines.zh: ：虽然我很{i}高兴{/i}{i}你{/i}回到{i}自己的{/i}身体里，但这又一次让我的处境变得非常艰难。

lines.en: : Apologies. Any reason for the strange amount of emphasis on words in that last sentence, though?
lines.zh: ：抱歉。不过，你刚才那句话里奇怪的重音是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Dodging memory lapses, perhaps.
lines.zh: ：也许是在回避记忆断片吧。

lines.en: : It would be rather inconvenient if I caused you to black out and subsequently felt pressured to fuck you back to life again with all of my friends in the next room over.
lines.zh: ：要是我害你昏过去，然后又迫于压力，得在朋友就在隔壁的情况下把你操活过来，那就太不方便了。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. That’s like the one thing I’ve been able to successfully tease you about. Please don’t take that away from me.
lines.zh: ：拜托。这可是我唯一能成功拿来调侃你的事了。别把它从我这儿抢走。

lines.en: scene goodmorning3
: Alas. It appears that all good things must come to an end.
lines.zh: ：唉。看来天下没有不散的筵席。

lines.en: Another minute of silence.
lines.zh: 又是一分钟沉默。

lines.en: Then another.
lines.zh: 然后又是一分钟。

lines.en: Then I lose again.
lines.zh: 然后我又输了。

lines.en: : So...you were really the one they sent over to wake me up this time?
lines.zh: ：所以……这次真的是他们派你来叫醒我的？

lines.en: : Ami normally jumps at the opportunity to be the first thing I see in the morning.
lines.zh: ：Ami 平时可是抢着要做我早上第一个看见的人。

lines.en: scene goodmorning4
: No one sent me anywhere. It just looks like we’re going to be leaving early today.
lines.zh: ：没人派我去哪儿。只是看样子今天要走得早。

lines.en: : And since I wasn’t able to eat breakfast on the way over, I’m taking a walk to the convenience store and am being kind enough to see if there is anything you want.
lines.zh: ：既然来的路上没吃成早饭，我打算走去便利店，顺便好心问问你想要点什么。

lines.en: : Are you...actually doing something nice for me?
lines.zh: ：你……其实是在为我做件好事？

lines.en: scene goodmorning5
: Nice? Of course not.
lines.zh: ：好事？当然不是。

lines.en: : It would just wind up saving all of us time in the long run if I could get everything done in one trip.
lines.zh: ：只不过要是我能一趟把事办完，长远来看能省下大家的时间。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: ：怎么？

lines.en: : It’s just a little funny to hear you of all people talking about saving time when-
lines.zh: ：只是听你这个人谈省时间，有点好笑，明明——

lines.en: : Yes, I get it. Haha. Funny joke.
lines.zh: ：是是是，我懂了。哈哈。真好笑。

lines.en: : Do you want anything or not?
lines.zh: ：你到底要不要？

lines.en: : I’m still waiting on that good morning kiss.
lines.zh: ：我还在等那个早安吻。

lines.en: scene goodmorning6
: I’m going to go ahead and take that as a no.
lines.zh: ：我就当你说不要了。

lines.en: : Congratulations on missing out on a chance for a free convenience store breakfast.
lines.zh: ：恭喜你，错失了一顿免费便利店早餐的机会。

lines.en: Another loss, but I earn a victory in the form of not being called disgusting, so it cancels out.
lines.zh: 又输一场，但我也赢下一局——没被骂恶心，所以扯平了。

lines.en: : Well, that was all I came here to ask, so-
lines.zh: ：嗯，我来就只是问这个，那么——

lines.en: : Wait. Hold on a second.
lines.zh: ：等等。等一下。

lines.en: : How many times must I decline your less-than-subtle advances before you realize that I’m not going to kiss you?
lines.zh: ：我要拒绝你这含蓄得可怜的示好多少次，你才会明白我不会吻你？

lines.en: : No, I get that part.
lines.zh: ：不，这我懂。

lines.en: : You just look a little different today.
lines.zh: ：你今天看起来有点不一样。

lines.en: scene goodmorning7
: Different?
lines.zh: ：不一样？

lines.en: : You mean because I’m not wearing my hair down?
lines.zh: ：你是说因为我没把头发披下来？

lines.en: : Yeah, that. And there’s no scarf either.
lines.zh: ：对，这个。而且也没围围巾。

lines.en: : What happened to all of that stuff about how you don’t like your neck getting cold?
lines.zh: ：你以前不是说脖子怕冷吗？那套说辞去哪了？

lines.en: : I am...surprised you remember that detail of all things.
lines.zh: ：我真……惊讶你居然偏偏记得这个细节。

lines.en: scene goodmorning8
: And while that may be an issue I’ll have to confront in the near future, I’d like to take this opportunity to remind you that everything from this point on is basically brand new to me.
lines.zh: ：虽然这也许是我不久之后必须面对的问题，但我想借这个机会提醒你：从这里往后的一切，对我来说基本都是全新的。

lines.en: : My inability to predict how things will play out from this point has tossed me into quite a bit of a predicament.
lines.zh: ：我无法预知接下来会怎么发展，这把我扔进了相当棘手的困境。

lines.en: : And so I’m attempting to circumvent my apparent lack of understanding of this city’s weather patterns by dressing in winter clothes while donning my summer haircut.
lines.zh: ：所以为了绕开我对这座城市气候规律明显的理解不足，我穿上了冬装，同时顶着夏天的发型。

lines.en: : Winter clothes minus the scarf, you mean.
lines.zh: ：你是说，冬装减去围巾。

lines.en: scene goodmorning9
: That...
: I just didn’t want to risk losing it.
lines.zh: ：我只是不想冒弄丢它的风险。

lines.en: : Anyway, bye.
lines.zh: ：总之，再见。

lines.en: : Don’t tell the others I came in here.
lines.zh: ：别跟别人说我进来过。

lines.en: scene goodmorning10
Maya leaves the room without looking back and I’m left to lie there in silence for another few minutes as I fight yet another battle of whether or not I’m going to get out of bed yet.
lines.zh: Maya 头也不回地离开了房间，剩下我躺在沉默里又待了几分钟，继续打另一场「到底要不要起床」的仗。

lines.en: scene black
I lose again.
lines.zh: 我又输了。

lines.en: {i}Welcome to the second special Lessons in Love beach update!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到《Lessons in Love》第二次特别海滩更新！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please enjoy the next twenty-one events (Or slightly less if you are bad at sex) and remember to savor every moment to your heart’s content!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请尽情享受接下来的二十一个事件（要是你床上功夫不行，可能会少几个），并记得把每一刻都细细品味到心满意足！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Just like last time, it’s sure to be filled with plenty of special memories and fun activities that’ll have you wishing to never go home!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}和上次一样，它一定会塞满特别的回忆和有趣的活动，让你恨不得永远别回家！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Unfortunately, even the sanctuaries that stitch themselves to the thick silhouettes of escape mechanisms tend to lose their grip from time to time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}遗憾的是，即便是那些把自己缝在逃避机制粗重轮廓上的庇护所，也会时不时地松手。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Will you lose your grip?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你会松手吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Or will you hold onto these precious days like the hand of a dying loved one?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}还是会像握住垂死之人的手那样，紧紧抓住这些珍贵的日子？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Smile always!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}永远微笑！{/i}

lines.en: {i}If you don’t, you lose!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不笑，你就输了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}And life is just a game after all, isn’t it?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}人生说到底不过是场游戏，不是吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}And all of this is fake, isn’t it?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而这一切都是假的，不是吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}But it’s all still beautiful, isn’t it?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但它依然很美，不是吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Why does everything have to hurt so much?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}为什么一切都非得这么疼？{/i}

lines.en: scene goodmorning11
: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: ：大家早上好。

lines.en: : Sensei! You’re up early! I was just about to come and get you.
lines.zh: ：Sensei！你起得真早！我正要去叫你呢。

lines.en: : Um...g...good morning...
lines.zh: ：呃……早……早上好……

lines.en: : Are you ready, Sensei?!
lines.zh: ：你准备好了吗，Sensei？！

lines.en: : Ready to brave the harsh winter winds and get lost in a weekend of fun in the sun even when the sun probably won’t be there?!
lines.zh: ：准备好迎着凛冽的寒风，在一个阳光下的欢乐周末里迷失自我了吗——哪怕太阳大概根本不会露面？！

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: ：没有。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see you’re feeling better, though.
lines.zh: ：不过看到你好些了，我很高兴。

lines.en: scene goodmorning12
: Uhh...thank you...
: Sorry for skipping[school] the last few days and stuff. Just been a little under the weather.
lines.zh: ：抱歉这几天没去[school]什么的。只是身体有点不太舒服。

lines.en: : I’m starting to feel better now, though. So...you don’t really have to worry about me.
lines.zh: ：不过我现在开始好起来了。所以……你其实不用为我担心。

lines.en: : I still have no idea what happened, but I’m glad to have you back, Ayane.
lines.zh: ：我还是不知道发生了什么，但很高兴你回来了，Ayane。

lines.en: : There's no denying that you are loud and obnoxious and like my [uncle] way too much, but things around here just aren’t the same without you.
lines.zh: ：不可否认，你又吵又烦，还太喜欢我[uncle]了，但没有你，这里就是不一样。

lines.en: scene goodmorning13
: I don’t just {i}like{/i} Sensei, Ami! I love him!
lines.zh: ：我不只是{i}喜欢{/i} Sensei，Ami！我爱他！

lines.en: : I love him and I don’t care who knows!
lines.zh: ：我爱他，谁知道了都不在乎！

lines.en: : Nevermind. You can go back to being sick now. I forgot how loud and obnoxious you actually were.
lines.zh: ：当我没说。你现在可以继续生病了。我都忘了你到底有多吵多烦。

lines.en: : Nonsense, Ami! We can love him together!
lines.zh: ：胡说，Ami！我们可以一起爱他！

lines.en: : I like loving him by myself more, thanks.
lines.zh: ：我更喜欢一个人爱他，谢了。

lines.en: : Sana, would you like to join in and proclaim your love for me as well?
lines.zh: ：Sana，你也要加入进来，向我表白吗？

lines.en: : Um...no thank you...
lines.zh: ：呃……不用了，谢谢……

lines.en: : But...I would like to know how exactly...a winter beach trip is going to work...
lines.zh: ：不过……我倒是想知道，冬天去海滩旅行到底……要怎么玩……

lines.en: : Like...the weather didn’t seem like it was going to be...suddenly hot or anything, so...
lines.zh: ：比方说……天气看起来也不会……突然变热什么的，所以……

lines.en: : Um...why are we even wearing our swimsuits?
lines.zh: ：呃……我们为什么要穿着泳衣啊？

lines.en: scene goodmorning14
: We’re wearing them {i}now{/i} because we have no idea if we’ll be able to once we get to the beach, Sana!
lines.zh: ：我们{i}现在{/i}穿着，是因为不知道到了海滩之后还能不能穿，Sana！

lines.en: : And just because the weather might be cold doesn’t mean we need to abandon our...beach spirit!
lines.zh: ：而且天气可能冷，也不代表我们要丢掉……海滩精神！

lines.en: : Beach...spirit?
lines.zh: ：海滩……精神？

lines.en: : The...spirit of the beach!
lines.zh: ：就是……海滩的精神！

lines.en: : You know what I’m talking about...right, Ami?
lines.zh: ：你知道我在说什么……对吧，Ami？

lines.en: : I have no clue what she’s talking about. I just wanted Sensei to see me in my new swimsuit and tell me how cute I am, but he hasn’t said anything yet.
lines.zh: ：我完全不知道她在说什么。我只是想让 Sensei 看看我的新泳衣，然后夸我可爱，可他到现在一句话都没说。

lines.en: scene goodmorning15
: All three of you are looking as cute as ever.
lines.zh: ：你们三个都和往常一样可爱。

lines.en: : Now, turn around and let me judge the backs of your swimsuits as well.
lines.zh: ：现在，转过身去，让我也评判一下泳衣的背面。

lines.en: Uta, Miku, and Futaba didn’t fall for it...but maybe these three will.
lines.zh: Uta、Miku 和 Futaba 没上当……但这三个说不定会。

lines.en: : Okay! Let’s do it, girls!
lines.zh: ：好！来吧，姐妹们！

lines.en: scene goodmorning16
: Better idea! How about you two leave and Sensei just gets a better look at the back of {i}my{/i} swimsuit?
lines.zh: ：更好的主意！你们俩先出去，让 Sensei 好好看看{i}我{/i}泳衣的背面怎么样？

lines.en: : I’ve already seen the backs of your swimsuits and can just clue him in on the details while he is helping me retie the drawstring on my bikini.
lines.zh: ：你们的泳衣背面我都看过了，可以趁他帮我重新系比基尼带子的时候，把细节讲给他听。

lines.en: : But I thought you said you tied it really tight since it’s still a little big for you and that you didn’t want it coming undone in the water.
lines.zh: ：可你不是说，因为对你来说还是有点大，所以系得特别紧，而且不想让它在水里散开吗？

lines.en: : {i}...Yes, Ayane.{/i} But maybe it’s still not tight enough and I need his help to fix it?
lines.zh: ：……{i}是啊{/i}，Ayane。但也许还是不够紧，我需要他帮忙调整一下？

lines.en: : You know, I wouldn’t mind helping you if-
lines.zh: ：你知道的，我也不介意帮你，如果——

lines.en: scene goodmorning17
: DAMN IT, AYANE! TAKE A HINT AND GET LOST ALREADY!
lines.zh: ：该死，AYANE！你倒是识相点赶紧滚啊！

lines.en: : Teehee~
lines.zh: ：嘻嘻~

lines.en: : Thank you for not making this morning any more exhausting for me, Sana.
lines.zh: ：谢谢你没让这个早晨变得更累人，Sana。

lines.en: : I hereby crown you the winner of this year’s Arakawa House Swimsuit Competition.
lines.zh: ：我在此加冕你为本年度荒川家泳衣大赛的冠军。

lines.en: : Um...that’s nice and everything, but...I...
lines.zh: ：呃……这很好之类的，可是……我……

lines.en: : I think I’m going to...put my normal clothes back on now...
lines.zh: ：我想我……还是把平时的衣服穿回去吧……

lines.en: : By all means, don’t let me get in the way.
lines.zh: ：请便，别让我碍着你了。

lines.en: : You...
: You’re in the way by being here...
lines.zh: ：你在这儿就是碍事……

lines.en: scene goodmorning18
The doorbell suddenly goes off and officially concludes the ending to the AHSC, a new competition I just made up and will absolutely remember if I’m fortunate enough to go on a third beach trip.
lines.zh: 门铃突然响了，正式为 AHSC 画上句号——这是我刚编出来的新比赛，要是有幸能去第三次海滩旅行，我一定会记得它。

lines.en: : Did...Maya lock herself out?
lines.zh: ：Maya……把自己锁在门外了吗？

lines.en: : No, Maya knows where the spare key is. I think that’s Karin.
lines.zh: ：不会，Maya 知道备用钥匙在哪儿。我想那是 Karin。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot she was going to tag along with you guys since her sister is a demon.
lines.zh: ：哦，对。我忘了她要跟你们一起去了，因为她姐姐是个恶魔。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
: Demon is a bit of an understatement, don’t you think?
lines.zh: ：说恶魔都有点轻描淡写了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : I’ll go let her in. Everybody, stay at least ten feet away from Sensei while I'm gone and-
lines.zh: ：我去让她进来。我不在的时候，所有人都离 Sensei 至少十英尺远，还有——

lines.en: : Actually, Ami- I'll let her in.
lines.zh: ：其实，Ami——我去让她进来。

lines.en: scene goodmorning19
: But Karin specifically asked me to let her in instead of you because you’re a boy and she’ll have a panic attack or something.
lines.zh: ：可 Karin 特意说要我去开门，而不是你，因为你是男的，她会恐慌发作什么的。

lines.en: : She was also under the impression you’d be in nothing but your boxers for some reason.
lines.zh: ：而且她不知道为什么，还以为你身上只穿了条四角裤。

lines.en: : Which I am not. So it should be fine if it’s me then, right?
lines.zh: ：可我不是。那我去就没问题了吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I’d still rather-
lines.zh: ：我是说……我还是更想——

lines.en: : Great. I’ll go let her in then.
lines.zh: ：很好。那我去让她进来。

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, Sensei! She really will have a panic attack!
lines.zh: ：等等，Sensei！她真的会恐慌发作的！

lines.en: I exit Ami’s room and make my way over to the front door to let Karin in.
lines.zh: 我走出 Ami 的房间，来到玄关给 Karin 开门。

lines.en: I also figure that if she {i}does{/i} wind up having a panic attack that she’s in the right place to do so since the couch isn’t that far away and I could just toss her onto it or something.
lines.zh: 我还想，就算她{i}真{/i}恐慌发作了，地点也挑得不错——沙发就在不远处，我直接把她扔上去就行。

lines.en: Also, I’m not sure if first aid would be required for something like that, but Ayane is Ayane and she’d probably know some way to handle it.
lines.zh: 另外，我不确定这种情况需不需要急救，但 Ayane 毕竟是 Ayane，她大概总有办法处理。

lines.en: scene goodmorning20
: H-H-H-H-H-H-H-H-H-House!
: Hi, Karin.
lines.zh: ：你好，Karin。

lines.en: scene goodmorning21
: R...Right...
: Hi is...the word I was looking for...
lines.zh: ：你好……就是我想说的那个词……

lines.en: scene goodmorning22
: U...Umm...could you show me which room is Ami’s?
lines.zh: ：呃……呃嗯……能告诉我哪间是 Ami 的房间吗？

lines.en: : She said she...had something to show me and...
lines.zh: ：她说她……有东西要给我看，还有……

lines.en: : And she...probably knows where it is...maybe...
lines.zh: ：而且她……大概知道在哪儿吧……可能……

lines.en: : Ami and the others left already.
lines.zh: ：Ami 她们已经走了。

lines.en: : I figured you and I could just hang out here for the rest of the day and then go to the beach ourselves.
lines.zh: ：我想着，你和我可以在这儿待一整天，然后再自己去海滩。

lines.en: scene goodmorning23
: T...Together?!
lines.zh: ：两……两个人？！

lines.en: : Here?!
lines.zh: ：在这儿？！

lines.en: : Ourselves?!
lines.zh: ：就我们两个？！

lines.en: : Beach?!
lines.zh: ：去海滩？！

lines.en: : Is that a problem?
lines.zh: ：有问题吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene goodmorning24
Karin dies.
lines.zh: Karin 当场去世。

lines.en: : Do you need help? Or can you-
lines.zh: ：需要我扶你吗？还是你能——

lines.en: : I...I can stand! I’m okay!
lines.zh: ：我……我能站起来！我没事！

lines.en: scene goodmorning25
: Ha ha! Legs! Am I right?!
lines.zh: ：哈哈！腿！我说得对吧？！

lines.en: : I...don’t know?
lines.zh: ：我……不知道？

lines.en: : I was just kidding about Ami not being here, though. Round the corner and her room is the first one on your left.
lines.zh: ：不过我刚才是骗你的，Ami 她们还在。转过弯，左手第一间就是她的房间。

lines.en: scene goodmorning26
: Ha...hahah...that was a...really funny prank you just pulled on me, Sensei...
lines.zh: ：哈……哈哈……Sensei，你刚才这个玩笑……真好笑……

lines.en: : It definitely wasn’t...really scary and...I’m definitely not a little...upset or anything that it’s not true...
lines.zh: ：绝对一点都……不吓人，而且我也绝对没有因为不是真的而……有点失落什么的……

lines.en: : Definitely not. Not at all.
lines.zh: ：绝对没有。一点都没有。

lines.en: : You’re so good at hiding how you really feel, Karin.
lines.zh: ：你可真会藏心思，Karin。

lines.en: scene goodmorning27
: I should have just taken the bus...
lines.zh: ：我当初就该坐公交来的……

lines.en: scene goodmorning28
: I’m back.
lines.zh: ：我回来了。

lines.en: : Everyone decided they didn’t want anything, so I just bought this since I am already historically bad at carrying things and-
lines.zh: ：大家都说不要什么了，所以我只买了这个，毕竟我拿东西一向很不在行，而且——

lines.en: scene goodmorning29
: And...
lines.zh: ：还有……

lines.en: : Um...h...hi, Maya...
lines.zh: ：呃……你……你好，Maya……

lines.en: scene goodmorning30
: Stay back! I paid money for this!
lines.zh: ：退后！这可是我花钱买的！

lines.en: : I’m...not going to attack the melon this time...
lines.zh: ：我……这次不会袭击那颗瓜的……

lines.en: : No! You’re not! Because I’m going to hide it!
lines.zh: ：对！你不会！因为我要把它藏起来！

lines.en: : My melon!
lines.zh: ：我的瓜！

lines.en: : Don’t follow me!
lines.zh: ：别跟过来！

lines.en: scene goodmorning31
scene goodmorning32
: She really likes watermelons for whatever reason.
lines.zh: ：不知道为什么，她特别喜欢西瓜。

lines.en: : I'm sure it's somehow relevant.
lines.zh: ：我敢肯定这背后总有缘由。

lines.en: : I...see that...
lines.zh: ：原……原来如此……

lines.en: scene goodmorning33
: {i}Ahem...{/i}
: So, the beach.
lines.zh: ：那么，海滩。

lines.en: Karin gently places her bag down by her feet and the three of us proceed to forget about the entire melon ordeal that nearly just turned this house into a crime scene.
lines.zh: Karin 轻轻把包放在脚边，我们仨便把刚才那场差点把这屋子变成凶宅的西瓜风波忘得一干二净。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah! Thanks for letting me tag along with you guys...
lines.zh: ：是……是的！谢谢你们让我跟着一起来……

lines.en: : Kirin was still being kind of mean this morning and...she didn’t really like it when I told her I was coming.
lines.zh: ：Kirin 今天早上还是有点凶，而且……我告诉她我要来的时候，她其实挺不高兴的。

lines.en: : You actually told her?
lines.zh: ：你还真跟她说了？

lines.en: scene goodmorning34
: I figured it would be a little better than just...surprising her and causing a scene.
lines.zh: ：我觉得这样总比……突然出现在她面前、然后闹一场要好一点。

lines.en: : Though...she’s already told me that if I {i}do{/i} come that she’s going to make a scene anyway, so...I have to meet up with her as soon as I get there.
lines.zh: ：不过……她已经说了，我要是{i}敢{/i}来她照样要闹，所以……我一到那儿就得先去见她。

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, you could avoid her altogether and let her self-destructive tendencies manifest in a way that won’t cause damage to you.
lines.zh: ：或者你也可以干脆躲着她，让她那套自我毁灭的倾向以伤不到你的方式发作出来。

lines.en: : Agreed. Confrontation is conceptually exhausting and should be avoided in nearly all cases where only one party is feeling emotionally vulnerable.
lines.zh: ：同意。对峙在概念上就很累人，凡是只有一方情绪脆弱的场合，几乎都该避免。

lines.en: : Does this mean you’re going to finally apologize to Noriko for exploding on her in the middle of class?
lines.zh: ：那这是不是说，你终于要为在课堂上对 Noriko 发火而道歉了？

lines.en: scene goodmorning35
: Nope.
: In fact, I’d laugh myself into a coma if I were to witness her being eaten by a shark this weekend.
lines.zh: ：事实上，要是这周末能亲眼看到她被鲨鱼吃掉，我能笑到昏迷。

lines.en: : No, you wouldn’t. Not because I think you secretly like her, but because I’m starting to doubt that you even know how to laugh.
lines.zh: ：不，你不会的。倒不是我觉得你暗地里喜欢她，而是我开始怀疑你到底会不会笑。

lines.en: : Don’t you think you should maybe just take into account the fact that you are not funny?
lines.zh: ：你是不是也该考虑一下「你并不好笑」这个事实？

lines.en: : Me? I’m hilarious.
lines.zh: ：我？我可搞笑了。

lines.en: : That statement alone is the closest you’ve come to a joke in literal centuries.
lines.zh: ：就这一句话，已经是你几百年来最接近一个笑话的东西了。

lines.en: : I...I know Sensei is older, but...I think centuries seems like a little much...
lines.zh: ：我……我知道 Sensei 年纪是比较大，但……说几百岁好像有点夸张了吧……

lines.en: scene goodmorning36
: Hey! Sorry I didn’t answer the door for you. I tried, but Sensei told me that he was going to do it instead and his word is law.
lines.zh: ：嘿！抱歉没去给你开门。我本来要去的，可 Sensei 说他要去，而他的话就是法律。

lines.en: : What? Since when?
lines.zh: ：什么？从什么时候开始的？

lines.en: scene goodmorning37
: Always, obviously!
lines.zh: ：一直如此，明摆着！

lines.en: : I’d kill for you if you asked me to, Sensei.
lines.zh: ：只要你开口，我可以为你去杀人，Sensei。

lines.en: : Aww. I knew you guys were close but I didn’t think it was {i}this{/i} close.
lines.zh: ：哇。我就知道你们关系好，但没想到好到{i}这种程度{/i}。

lines.en: : Yes. Adorable.
lines.zh: ：是啊。真可爱。

lines.en: : But as much as I’d love to stay and talk about Ami’s unhealthy obsession with Sensei and how {i}incredibly normal{/i} it is, I have a melon to eat.
lines.zh: ：虽然我很想留下来聊 Ami 对 Sensei 那种不健康的痴迷，以及它有{i}多么正常{/i}，但我还有一颗瓜要吃。

lines.en: scene goodmorning38
: Can’t you just eat it here if it's that big of a deal?
lines.zh: ：要是真那么要紧，你不能就在这儿吃吗？

lines.en: : Here? Instead of on the beach? Are you insane?
lines.zh: ：在这儿？而不是在海滩上？你疯了吗？

lines.en: : Everyone knows that the beach is the best place to enjoy a watermelon. I don’t mind waiting at all if that’s a feasible option.
lines.zh: ：谁都知道海滩才是吃西瓜的最佳地点。只要可行，我等一等完全不介意。

lines.en: : I just don’t want to wait {i}too much{/i} because, well...melon.
lines.zh: ：我只是不想等{i}太久{/i}，因为，嗯……瓜。

lines.en: scene goodmorning39
: Well...all of us girls are ready to go whenever.
lines.zh: ：嗯……我们女生随时都可以出发。

lines.en: : I think we’re just waiting on Sensei to pack his things before heading over to the bus stop.
lines.zh: ：我想我们只是在等 Sensei 收拾好东西，然后就去车站。

lines.en: : I’m...also ready whenever you want to leave. I wouldn’t want to be a burden by messing up your plans, so...my schedule is entirely up to you guys.
lines.zh: ：我……也随时都可以走。我不想因为打乱你们的计划而成为累赘，所以……我的时间完全听你们的。

lines.en: : Melon.
: Yes, Maya. Melon.
lines.zh: ：是，Maya。瓜。

lines.en: : Melon now.
lines.zh: ：现在就吃瓜。

lines.en: : Melon now.
lines.zh: ：现在就吃瓜。

lines.en: scene wintersky
I wind up packing up my things rather quickly given that we’re only going to be gone for two days and that I...barely have anything to bring either way.
lines.zh: 我收拾东西收拾得相当快，毕竟我们只去两天，而且我……本来也没什么可带的。

lines.en: Then, before long, the six of us make our way over to the bus stop, each carrying our own possessions apart from Karin- who is repenting for the watermelon tragedy by carrying Maya’s bag.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我们六个人就动身前往车站，各自拿着自己的行李，只有 Karin 例外——她正以帮 Maya 背包的方式，为那场西瓜惨剧赎罪。

lines.en: She offered to carry the melon itself, but...well, you can probably imagine how that went.
lines.zh: 她主动提出要抱那颗瓜，不过……嗯，结果大概可想而知。

lines.en: A few minutes go by with us waiting at the bus stop and gazing up at the sky, trying to figure out whether or not the snow will end by the time we get to the beach.
lines.zh: 我们在车站等了几分钟，抬头望着天，想弄清楚等我们到海滩时雪会不会停。

lines.en: Or if it’s even snowing there to begin with.
lines.zh: 或者说，那儿到底下不下雪。

lines.en: It would be easy to check the weather and find out within a matter of seconds, but it’s not like any of us really trust weather forecasts in the first place.
lines.zh: 查一下天气几秒钟就能知道，可我们本来就不怎么信天气预报。

lines.en: Besides, life is better with an added layer of mystery thrown into the mix.
lines.zh: 再说了，人生多加一层神秘感才更有意思。

lines.en: Life is better with an added layer of basically anything thrown into the mix, though.
lines.zh: 不过，人生里加进几乎任何一层东西都会更好。

lines.en: But that’s mostly because it just sucks on its own and requires a multitude of spices to be even somewhat palatable.
lines.zh: 但这主要是因为它本身就难吃得要命，得撒上一堆调料才勉强能入口。

lines.en: scene black
The bus arrives just as the snowfall ends and we all pack our things into overhead storage receptacles- melon included.
lines.zh: 雪一停，巴士就来了，我们把行李全塞进头顶的行李架——包括那颗瓜。

lines.en: Ami and I sit together as everyone else finds a different place on the bus.
lines.zh: Ami 和我坐在一起，其他人各自找了别的位置。

lines.en: She falls asleep on my shoulder on the way and I can make out the faint smell of her shampoo.
lines.zh: 路上她靠在我肩上睡着了，我能闻见她洗发水淡淡的香味。

lines.en: It’s different than normal.
lines.zh: 和平时不一样。

lines.en: And slightly nostalgic.
lines.zh: 还有点让人怀念。

lines.en: : Hm?
I get a text message just as I’m about to close my eyes as well and look down at my phone to see who it is.
lines.zh: 就在我也快要合上眼睛的时候，收到一条短信，我低头看手机，想看看是谁。

lines.en: Chances are it’s just Ayane on the other side of the bus, checking in to see what I’m-
lines.zh: 八成是坐在巴士另一头的 Ayane，来问我在干——

lines.en: : {i}Hey.{/i}
: {i}Hey.{/i}
: {i}Are you busy this weekend?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：这周末有空吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you actually trying to make plans with me?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：你是在认真约我？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you busy or not? I don’t have all day to be texting, you know.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：你到底有没有空？我可没一整天陪你发短信。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}In case you don’t remember, I’m very, very famous.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：提醒你一下，我非常非常有名。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sorry, but I have plans.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：抱歉，我有安排了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We can do something when I get back, though.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：不过我回来之后可以一起做点什么。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay.{/i}
: {i}Bye then I guess.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：那就这样，拜拜。{/i}

lines.en: My phone finds its way through a maze of even more nostalgia (There’s quite a bit of it on this bus) and makes its way back into my pocket.
lines.zh: 我的手机穿过又一阵怀旧的迷宫（这辆巴士上怀旧的东西还真不少），回到了我的口袋里。

lines.en: I gaze out of the window, letting the scent of Ami’s hair invade my nostrils, and find the skeleton of a fully decomposed animal.
lines.zh: 我望着窗外，任由 Ami 发丝的气味钻进鼻腔，然后看见了一具完全腐烂的动物骨架。

lines.en: One I recall seeing sometime before.
lines.zh: 我记得以前见过它。

lines.en: I think of how it died.
lines.zh: 我想着它是怎么死的。

lines.en: And ultimately follow that train of thought up to the point where it becomes far too dangerous to follow anymore.
lines.zh: 然后一路顺着这条思路想下去，直到再想下去就太危险为止。

lines.en: I jump off board and chase after it, though.
lines.zh: 可我还是跳下车去追它了。

lines.en: Hoping that wherever it’s heading is somewhere I’ll be able to see some day.
lines.zh: 希望它去往的地方，有朝一日我也能看见。

lines.en: But then I lose again.
lines.zh: 但接着我又输了。

lines.en: $ maya_love += 1
$ secondbeach1 = True
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}
